edit.description: the gate roster's producer-only arm, and the module doc naming which members it withholds

summary: the `per` gate joins the goal-rank gate in the producer-only arm of the roster, so a build commit is never refused over a cite it cannot repair
acceptance: a build phase's gate set carries no `per` gate, a plan slice's still does, and the roster's doc names the three members it withholds rather than two
tests: a build commit whose queue carries a stranded per cite is not refused
pins: a plan commit whose queue carries a stranded per cite is refused
a build phase's gate set carries no goal rank gate
notes: `harnessGates` already gates `goalRankGate` and the merged-tree pending gate on `isQueueProducer`; `perGate` is unconditional. Same files as A-NEW-BLOCKER-NAMES-AN-ENTRY-THE-QUEUE-CARRIES (its sibling out of this section) and as the in-flight THE-RECORDS-GATE-TAKES-THE-STEPS-OFF-ITS-CONTEXT, so all three serialize on the roster they share.
